name: components-community-notification-list
title: Notification List
blurb: Stacked notification cards that fan out and scale on hover with spring…
description: Motion-animated notification list with stacked card layout that expands on hover, each card scales and offsets via spring physics. Shows title, subtitle, time, optional count indicator.
use_when: You need a compact notification center that expands to show full list on interaction.
avoid_when: For always-visible notification lists; use static or popover-based layouts instead.
a11y: Hover interaction only; no keyboard alternative provided. Motion respects prefers-reduced-motion.
